standInReason: yEd (and Graphlet, for the GML draft's keys) cannot run on this machine; this is Graphviz's own drawing of gml2gv's conversion, pinned at the file's x/y with neato -n2. gml2gv maps fill to the outline color (no style=filled), keeps GML's y-down coordinates in Graphviz's y-up space (mirrored top to bottom), files LabelGraphics fontSize as a font name (so every label is 14 pt), reads Line points as spline control points, copies yEd's style names (line, dashed_dotted) that Graphviz does not know, and reads no arrow, anchor, model, fill2, fontStyle or group key.
